challengeTypes: identify: What do we use to CLICK on the computer? (Mouse vs Monitor vs Speaker)
identify: What do we use to TYPE letters and numbers? (Keyboard vs Mouse vs Monitor)
identify: Which key makes a SPACE between words? (Spacebar vs Enter vs Delete)
sort: Drag keys to what they do (Space: spacebar | New line: enter | Remove: delete | Type: letter keys)
identify: Where do we SAVE our files and pictures? (Storage vs Screen vs Mouse)
identify: Should we eat and drink near the computer? (No vs Yes vs Only water)
sort: Drag items to safe vs unsafe near computer (Safe: clean hands, gentle typing | Unsafe: food, water, banging keys)
sort: Drag input devices to the right type (Point/click: mouse | Type: keyboard | Store: USB drive, hard disk)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Mouse — left click to select, right click for menu, scroll wheel to scroll. (2) Keyboard — letter keys A-Z, number keys 0-9, each key has a job. (3) Special keys — spacebar makes spaces, enter goes to next line, delete removes things. (4) Storage — keeps files safe (USB drive, hard disk). (5) Safety — press keys softly, no food/water near computer, wash hands before use. Misconceptions: 'press keys as hard as possible' (press softly, computer is not a drum), 'eat and drink near computer' (spills damage computer), 'all keys do the same thing' (each key has a special job). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ComputerInputGame), NOT export default. Export interface ComputerInputGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
